name: The Tier List Tribunal
why_it_works: Tier lists invite disagreement, and disagreement is comments. Placing a popular choice in a low tier gives viewers something to argue about, while the expert reasoning makes {{brand}} the authority. The format also rewards rewatching to see where each item landed.

hook.pattern: Start with a controversial placement already on the board, then defend it.
examples: I put {{hot_take_item}} in D tier. Let me explain.
Ranking every {{topic}} from S to F. Fight me in the comments.
{{hot_take_item}} is overrated. Here's the whole tier list.

variables.name: s_tier_reason
variables.description: Why it is S tier, one line
variables.example: low impact, easy to repeat daily

variables.name: a_tier_item
variables.description: A solid but not perfect pick

variables.name: hot_take_item
variables.description: A popular choice you rank low

variables.name: hot_take_reason
variables.description: Why it ranks low, one honest line
variables.example: it feels hard but asks little of you

beats.voiceover: I put {{hot_take_item}} in D tier. Let me explain.

visual.prompt: Vertical tier list board with S, A, B, C, D, F rows in bold colors, a single card labeled {{hot_take_item}} already sitting in D, bright flat studio light, 9:16
Clean vertical photo of {{s_tier_item}} in a real setting connected to {{brand}}, crisp light, gold S badge in the top corner

beats.voiceover: A tier: {{a_tier_item}}. Great, with one catch.

visual.prompt: A card labeled {{hot_take_item}} slides down the tier board from A to D, simple motion graphic feel, bold colors, vertical 9:16
{{f_tier_item}} on a plain gray background with a red F stamp, flat light, vertical

beats.purpose: comment bait and call to action
beats.voiceover: Where would you put {{hot_take_item}}? Tell me, and follow {{brand}} for part two.

cta: Drop your tier list in the comments and follow {{brand}} for part two.

craft.technique: Open on the verdict, then the trial
craft.notes: Show the most arguable placement in frame one so the viewer is already reacting before you speak. The reason for the low rank must be fair and specific; a cheap shot reads as clickbait, a sharp reason reads as expertise. End with a question, not a statement.

do_not: Put a named real brand or product in a low tier
Give the hot take no reason; it reads as rage bait
Rank more than five or six items in under 25 seconds
compliance: Skincare and fitness claims: no promises of medical or weight-loss results; rank on experience and ease, not health outcomes
